text_block_list.name: Shady Fortune Teller
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, you young lady over there! I see a 
terrible aura about you... At this rate, 
disaster will befall your master...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: My mentor... Do you mean my Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
Your Highness, you have no need to lend an 
ear to such nonsense...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
No, jumping to conclusions is not good. We 
must listen until the end first. Besides, 
we still have time until training...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Excuse me. Please, do carry on♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
“—I see. I understand very well just how 
deeply and genuinely you worry about 
me...”

text_block_list.name: Fortune Teller
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, I simply can't look the other way 
when someone's having bad luck... Don't 
worry about the fee, just listen up!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"My, aren't you kind? Going out of your 
way for a total stranger who isn't even a 
customer..."

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
Your Highness, we are running out of 
time...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me... Would you mind letting me 
speak with this person for just a little 
longer?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Her sincerity is genuine... Besides, if 
the fortune-telling came true, Trainer 
would be worried.

Fine Motion ended up listening to the 
details and skipping training.
